title: REQ · Pipeline generates nine-slice frame PNGs and the old frame, sound and pointer SVGs are gone
summary: Palette-grid sources for bar, panel, plaque, parchment card, slot, four button states
description: Context: ART_SOURCES holds only the hand cursor from the UI set. Desired: pure grid builder and FRAME_KIT registry producing 9 frames, registered in ART_SOURCES, generated by art:generate into public/assets/ui/frames with manifest entries; hand cursor kept. Expected: PNGs sized as declared using palette only. Why: frames for components.
acceptance_criteria: Given buildFrameGrid, when called with a spec, then the grid has the declared width and height and only palette indices
Given FRAME_KIT, when listed, then it has bar, panel, plaque, parchment, slot, button-normal, button-hover, button-pressed and button-disabled with a slice smaller than half each dimension
Given the committed manifest, when read, then each frame id has a PNG at the declared size
Given game/public, when listed, then no svg named panel-frame, sound or pointer exists
definition_of_done: PNGs and manifest committed via art:generate
